summary: Iteration 10: tested the API-Sports feed switch (backend and frontend). Backend pytest test_apisports_feed.py passed 9/9. GET /api/odds returns 20 'as-soccer-<id>' events, all with book 'API-Sports', media.api-sports.io logos, moneyline home/draw/away and total Over/Under 2.5. Events without markets are hidden (414 cached, 20 shown). ?league=soccer filters correctly. Single bet and 2-leg parlay placed (0.5 USDT each). The server re-prices them: tampered odds -> 409 'changed', an unknown event -> 409 'unavailable', a FINAL event -> 409. Cash-out quotes return numbers for the new bets. Quota: 5 /api/odds calls over ~40s did not change any feed_cache ts (aps:soccer/basketball/hockey/baseball/football all present). US sports show 0 events, as expected (SGO returns 429). Frontend: 20 soccer cards, all 40 logos load, sidebar Soccer count 20 matches the cards. Clicking odds adds the pick to the slip. Placing a bet shows a 'Bet placed!' toast and the bet appears in My Bets with a Cash out value. Mobile 390px has no horizontal overflow.

critical.issue: Past-posting risk: soccer data is cached for up to 3600s, and _verify_selections only rejects state=='post'. A match that kicked off (or even finished) within the last hour is still 'pre' in the cache, with pre-match odds, and it accepts bets. After the cache refresh, the API-Sports /odds pre-match prices for in-play fixtures are still served as 'in' events, so live bets are taken at stale pre-match prices. Fix: reject any selection where now >= ev.start (or allow only pre-match for API-Sports events), and drop markets for state 'in'.

minor.issue: If the upstream returns errors (quota exhausted, bad key), _get returns [], and _aps_sport caches data=[] as a SUCCESS with ts=now. This wipes the previous events for a full TTL: the board goes empty, open bets cannot be settled, and cash-out is suspended. Raise on data['errors'] so the existing 'keep old doc and retry in 10 min' branch is used.

Soccer uses 4 calls per refresh (2 fixtures + 2 odds pages), which is about 96/day at a 3600s TTL. That is almost the 100/day limit, and failure retries every 10 min can exceed it. Odds are only fetched for today's date, 2 pages (about 20 fixtures), so most fixtures stay hidden.
Finished (state=post) events are returned with markets: 3 'Match Finished' cards show on the board with clickable odds that always get a 409. Filter out post events, or strip their markets.

15 of the 18 open bets in the DB have legs on old SportsGameOdds/ESPN event ids that are no longer in the feed. They can never settle or cash out ('Cash out unavailable' forever). They need a void/refund migration.
Every 30s, each /api/odds call makes about 10 SGO requests one after another, which return 429 (about 1.6s added latency, and keeps the rate limit hot). Use a longer back-off on 429.

ui_bugs.issue: The selected state never shows. has(sel) is called with {...s, market}, which has no event_id, so selId is 'undefined:market:side'. The button never turns emerald after a click. Fix: has({...sel, event_id: meta.event_id}). This bug existed before this change.
Odds buttons on FINAL cards can still be clicked. Disable them, or hide the markets when state==='post'.

issues: The hero label still says 'LIVE ODDS · SPORTSGAMEODDS' and the sidebar footer says 'Live odds from SportsGameOdds · 85+ bookmakers'. The copy mentions NBA/MLB, but only soccer is shown.
The card lists away above home, but the moneyline buttons are in home/draw/away order (NOR ML first while ORE is the top row). This is confusing.
Legs show only the pick ('Draw', 'Over 2.5') with no match name. For soccer this is ambiguous. Show home vs away under each leg.

action_items: HIGH: block bets on events whose start time has passed (and on cached 'in' events with pre-match odds) in _verify_selections
Treat API-Sports 'errors' responses as failures so the cache keeps the last good data
Hide finished events (or their markets) from /api/odds and disable their odds buttons
Fix the OddsButton active state (pass event_id to has())
Update the SportsGameOdds branding text in the hero/sidebar; show the match name in My Bets legs
Void/refund the orphaned open bets on legacy event ids
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2246 lines; move the feed/merge logic (_aps_sport, _fetch_sgo_sequential) and betting into separate modules
_fetch_sgo_sequential still has its old name but now merges API-Sports and SGO; rename it for clarity
Selection model requires league_label/home/away but the server never checks them against the event (client-supplied display data stored on the bet)

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 tests); 1 high-risk logic gap found in code review

seed_data_creation: Placed 3 bets of 0.5 USDT on player@apexodds.io: a single on home ML for as-soccer-1497724, a single on Draw for as-soccer-1556863 (UI), and a parlay of Over 2.5 + Draw. feed_cache was not cleared.

Selections need league_label/home/away fields. Do not clear feed_cache (quota).
